spans.s: मत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Thought, supposed; 2. considered, deemed, regarded; 3. conjectured; 4. honoured, respected; 5. commended, valued; 6. meditated upon, perceived, recognized; 7. assented to, approved, consented to, (pp. of मन् q.v.).
मत (II) n. 1. Opinion, view, belief, Bt.xviii.6; 2. doctrine, creed, tenet, ये ते मतमिदं नित्यमनुतिष्ठति मानवाः Bg.iii.31; 3. counsel, advice; 4. design, aim, purpose; 5. approbation, commendation.

मत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Thought, supposed; 2. considered, deemed, regarded; 3. conjectured; 4. honoured, respected; 5. commended, valued; 6. meditated upon, perceived, recognized; 7. assented to, approved, consented to, (pp. of मन् q.v.).

मत्त (I) a. (f. त्ता) 1. Intoxicated, inebriated, पुंस्कोकिलश्चूतरसेन मत्तः प्रियामुखं चुंबति Rt.vi.15; (used metaphorically also, e.g. धनमत्त, बलमत्त, ऐश्वर्यमत्त); 2. mad, furious, R.xii.93; 3. amorous, wanton; 4. proud, arrogant; 5. delighted, overjoyed.
मत्त (II) m. 1. An. elephant in rut; 2. a drunkard; 3. a madman; 4. a buffalo; 5. the Indian cuckoo; 6. the Dhattūra plant.

मत्त (I) a. (f. त्ता) 1. Intoxicated, inebriated, पुंस्कोकिलश्चूतरसेन मत्तः प्रियामुखं चुंबति Rt.vi.15; (used metaphorically also, e.g. धनमत्त, बलमत्त, ऐश्वर्यमत्त); 2. mad, furious, R.xii.93; 3. amorous, wanton; 4. proud, arrogant; 5. delighted, overjoyed.
माता f. A mother.
मत-अक्ष a. skilled in dice.
मत-अन्तर n. 1. another’s opinion; 2. a different creed.
मत-अवलम्बन n. the holding a particular opinion.
मतंग m. 1. An elephant; 2. a cloud; 3. name of a sage, R.v.53.
मातंग m. 1. An elephant; 2. a man of the lowest caste, a Chaṇḍāla; 3. a kirāta, a barbarian; 4. (at the end of a compound) anything the best of its kind.
मतंग-ज m. an elephant, क्षणविमत्तमतंगजवर्जितैः Kir.v.47, R.xii.73.
मतल्लिका f. (at the end of a compound only) Anything excellent of its kind, e.g. गोमतल्लिका ‘an excellent cow.’
मतल्ली f. The same as मतल्लिका q.v.
मातलि m. Name of the charioteer of Indra.

मति f. 1. Understanding, intellect, sense, judgment, क्व सूर्यप्रभवो वंशः क्व चाल्पविषया मतिः R.i.2, Sis.ix.62; 2. design, intention, purpose, पलांडुं गृंजनं चैव मत्या जग्ध्वा M.v.19; 3. opinion, notion, impression, belief, view, तत्र श्रीर्विजयो भूतिर्ध्रुवा नीतिर्मतिर्मम Bg.xviii.78; 4. counsel, advice; 5. wish, desire, inclination; 6. respect, regard, reverence; 7. remembrance, recollection.(मत्या is used as an indeclinable in the sense of- (1) knowingly, intentionally, M.v.19; (2) under the impression that, e.g. व्याघ्रमत्या. मतिं कृ ‘to intend, to think of.’)
माति f. 1. Measure; 2. conception, idea.
मति-ईश्वर m. an epithet of Viśvakarman.
मति-गर्भ a. clever, intelligent.
मति-द्वैध n. difference of opinion.
मति-निश्चय m. a firm conviction.
मति-पूर्वम्, -पूर्वकम् ind. knowingly, wittingly, purposely, intentionally.
मति-पूर्वम्, -पूर्वकम् ind. knowingly, wittingly, purposely, intentionally.
मति-प्रकर्ष m. talent, cleverness.
मति-भेद m. change of opinion.
मति-भ्रम m. misapprehension, error.
मति-भ्रांति f. misapprehension, error.
मति-मत् a. clever, intelligent, wise, R.v.66.
मति-विभ्रंश, -विभ्रम m. madness, lunacy.
मति-विभ्रंश, -विभ्रम m. madness, lunacy.
मति-शालिन् a. intelligent, clever.
मति-हीन a. senseless, stupid.
मत्क (I) m. (fem. त्का) Mine, my, संश्रुणुष्व कपे मत्कैः संगच्छस्व वनैः शुभैः Bt.viii.16.
मत्क (II) m. A bug.
मत्कुण (I) m. 1. A bug, मत्कुणाविव पुरा परिप्लवौ Sis.xiv.68; 2. an elephant without tusks; 3. a small elephant; 4. a buffalo; 5. a beardless man; 6. the cocoanut tree.
मत्कुण (II) n. An armour for the thighs.
मत्कुण-अरि m. hemp.
मत्त-आलम्ब m. a fence round a mansion.
मत्त-इभ m. an elephant in rut.
मत्त-इभ˚गमना f. a woman having the gait of an elephant in rut.
मत्त-काशिनी, -कासिनी f. a very beautiful and fascinating woman.
मत्त-काशिनी, -कासिनी f. a very beautiful and fascinating woman.

मत्त-नाग (II) m.n. 1. a fence round a mansion; 2. a little room on the top of a large house; 3. a pavilion.
मत्त-नाग (III) n. pounded betel-nut.
मत्य n. 1. A harrow; 2. the means of acquiring knowledge; 3. the exercise of knowledge.
मत्स m. 1. A fish; 2. a king of the Matsyas.
मत्सर (I) a. (f. रा) 1. Envious, jealous; 2. greedy, covetous; 3. wicked.
मत्सर (II) m. 1. Envy, jealousy, hostility, त्वयि मत्सरादिव निरस्तदयः सुतरां क्षिणोति खलु तां मदनः Sis.ix.63, K.S.v.17, Yaj.i.268; 2. greediness; 3. anger, passion; 4. a musquito.
मत्सर (I) a. (f. रा) 1. Envious, jealous; 2. greedy, covetous; 3. wicked.
मात्सर a. (f. री) Jealous, envious, malicious.

मत्सरिन् a. (f. णी) 1. Envious, jealous, inimical, वैरायितारस्तरलाः स्वयं मत्सरिणः परे Sis.ii.115, परवृद्धिमत्सरि मनो हि मानिनाम् xv.1; 2. greedy after, addicted to, (with a loc.); 3. depraved, wicked.

मत्स्य-अक्षी f. a medicinal plant.
मत्स्य-अद्, -आद a. feeding on fish.
मत्स्य-अद्, -आद a. feeding on fish.

मत्स्य-अवतार m. Viṣṇu in his first incarnation; (when the seventh Manu was reigning, the whole earth was destroyed by a flood and all living beings perished except the reigning Manu and the seven Ṛshis who were saved by Viṣṇu in the form of a fish), प्रलयपयोधिजले धृतवान्सि वेदम् । विहितवहित्रचरित्रमखेदम् । केशव धृत मीनशरीर Git.G.i.
मत्स्य-अशन m. a king-fisher.
मत्स्य-असुर m. name of a demon.
मत्स्य-आधानी, -धानी f. a small basket used by fishermen.
मत्स्य-आधानी, -धानी f. a small basket used by fishermen.
मत्स्य-उदरिन् m. an epithet of Virāṭa.

मत्स्य-उदरीय m. an epithet of Vyāsa.

मत्स्य-करंडिका f. a basket for fish.
मत्स्य-गंधा f. an epithet of Satyavatī.

मत्स्य-बंध, -बंधिन् m. a fisherman.

मत्स्य-वेधनी f. an angle.

मातंग-दिवाकर m. name of a poet.
मातंग-नक्र m. a crocidile as big as an elephant, R.xiii.11.
मातलि-सारथि m. an epithet of Indra.
मातुल m. 1. A maternal uncle, Bg.i.26, M.ii.130; 2. the Dhattūra plant; 3. a kind of snake.
मातुला f. 1. The wife of a maternal uncle, M.ii.131; 2. hemp.
मातुल-अहि m. a kind of snake.
मातुल-पुत्रक m. 1. the fruit of the thorn-apple; 2. the son of a maternal uncle.

मातुलिंग (I) m. A kind of citron tree, भुवो भागाः प्रेङ्खितमातुलुंगवृतयः प्रेयो विधास्यंति वाम् M.M.vi.

मातुलुंग (II) n. The frnit of this tree.
मातुलेय m. (fem. ˚यी) The son of a maternal uncle.

मातृ (I) f. 1. A mother, मातुर्दुहितरश्शेषम् Yaj.ii.111, 123, 139, 143, M.ii.50; 2. cow; 3. an epithet of Lakṣmī; 4. an epithet of Durgā; 5. the earth; 6. a divine mother, मातृभ्यो बलिमुपहर Mrich.i.; (they are variously enumerated); 7. a respectful term used in addressings elderly women.

मातृ (II) f. pl. Name of the divine mothers attending on Śiva; they are eight (ब्राह्मी माहेश्वरी चंडी वाराही वैष्णवी तथा । कौमारी चैव चामुंडा चर्चिकेत्यष्ट मातरः); according to some, they are seven (ब्राह्मी माहेश्वरी चैव कौमारी वैष्णवी तथा । वाराही च तथेंद्राणी चामुंडा सप्त मातरः).
मातृ-केशट m. a maternal uncle.
मातृ-गण m. the assemblage of divine mothers.
मातृ-गंधिनी f. an unnatural mother.
मातृ-गामिन् m. one who has committed incest with his mother.
मातृ-गोत्र n. a mother’s family.

मातृ-घातुक m. 1. a matricide; 2. an epithet of Indra.
मातृ-देव a. revering a mother like a god.
मातृ-नंदन m. an epithet of Kārtikeya.
मातृ-पक्ष a. belonging to the maternal line.
मातरपितरौ m. du. parents.
मातरपितरौ m. du. parents.
मातापुत्रौ m. du. mother and son.
मातरिपुरुष m. a cowardly bully, (who can act the part of a man only against his mother). Cf. पितरिशूर.
मातृ-पूजन n. worship of the divine mothers.
मातृ-बंधु, -बांधव m. name of a class of relations on the mother’s side; (they are- मातुः पितुः स्वसुः पुत्रा मातुर्मातुः स्वसुः सुता । मातुर्मातुलपुत्राश्च विज्ञेया मातृबंधवः).
मातृ-बंधु, -बांधव m. name of a class of relations on the mother’s side; (they are- मातुः पितुः स्वसुः पुत्रा मातुर्मातुः स्वसुः सुता । मातुर्मातुलपुत्राश्च विज्ञेया मातृबंधवः).
मातृ-मंडल n. the assemblage of divine mothers.
मातामह (I) m. a maternal grandfather, M.iii.148.
मातामह (II) m. du. grandfather and grandmother on the mother’s side.
मातामही f. a maternal grandmother.
मातृ-मातृ f. an epithet of Pārvatī.
मातृ-मुख m. a simpleton.
मातृ-यज्ञ m. a sacrifice to the Mātṛs.
मातृ-वत्सल m. an epithet of Kārtikeya.
मातरिश्वन् m. wind, air, बद्धां बद्धां भित्तिशंकाममुष्मिन्नावानावान् Kir.v.36.
मातृष्वसृ f. a mother’s sister, a maternal aunt.
मातृष्वसृ f. a mother’s sister, a maternal aunt.
मातृष्वसेय m. (fem. ˚यी) the son of a maternal aunt.
मातृष्वस्रीय m. (fem. ˚या) the son of a maternal aunt.
मातृक (I) a. (f. का) Coming from a mother, पित्र्यमंशमुपवीतलक्षणं मातृकं च धनुस्वर्जितं दधन् R.xi.64, 90.
मातृक (II) m. A maternal uncle.
मातृक (I) a. (f. का) Coming from a mother, पित्र्यमंशमुपवीतलक्षणं मातृकं च धनुस्वर्जितं दधन् R.xi.64, 90.
मातृका (I) f. 1. A mother; 2. a nurse; 3. a grandmother; 4. source, origin; 5. the alphabet employed in certain diagrams for magical purposes; 6. a divine mother.
मातृका (II) f. pl. the alphabet.
मात्र (I) a. (f. त्री or त्रा) An affix added to nouns to denote ‘measuring as much as,’ ‘reaching as far as’ e.g. ऊरुमात्र.

मात्र (II) n. 1. Measure of any kind (either of height, breadth, time, space or number); (in this sense, it is found at the end of nouns, e.g. अंगुलमात्रम् ‘the breadth of a finger,’ क्रोशमात्रे ‘at the distance of a koś,’ रेखामात्रमपि ‘even the breadth of a line’ R.i.17, क्षणमात्रम् ‘the space of a moment,’ निमेषमात्रात् ‘in an instant’ R.iii.61); 2. the full measure of anything, the entire class of things, the whole, the totality, e.g. प्राणिमात्रम् ‘the whole class of sentient beings’; 3. the one thing and no more; (in this sense, the word is translatable by ‘only, just, mere, even,’ e.g. वर्णमात्रेण कृष्णः ‘black only in colour,’ Megh.i.49, R.xii.10, M.viiii.20, ix.106).(When joined to a past passive participle, मात्र has the sense of ‘as soon as,’ ‘no sooner than’ e.g. प्रविष्टमात्र एव तत्रभवति Sak.iii.)
मात्र (I) a. (f. त्री or त्रा) An affix added to nouns to denote ‘measuring as much as,’ ‘reaching as far as’ e.g. ऊरुमात्र.

मात्रा f. (the word is used in all the senses of मात्र) 1. A unit of measure; 2. the correct measure; 3. a moment; 4. a particle, an atom; 5. a small portion, a little, पिंडेन्य्स्त्वल्पिकां मात्रांसमादाय M.iii.219, R.iii.11; 6. an element; 7. the material world; 8. money, wealth, substance; 9. an ornament, a jewel; 10. the upper limb of the Nāgarī characters; 11. retinue; 12. a syllabic instant (in prosody).(का or कियती मात्रा ‘of what account or consideration,’ e.g. गजेति का मात्रा मम.)
मात्र (I) a. (f. त्री or त्रा) An affix added to nouns to denote ‘measuring as much as,’ ‘reaching as far as’ e.g. ऊरुमात्र.
मात्रा-अर्ध n. the half of a syllabic instant.
मात्रा-भस्त्रा f. a money-bag.
मात्रा-वृत्त n. a metre governed by the number of syllabic instants.
मात्रा-संग m. attachment to household possessions, M.vi.57.
मात्रा-स्पर्श m. contact of the organs of sense with material elements, Bg.ii.14.
मात्रिका f. A syllabic instant (in prosody).

मात्स्यिक m. A fisherman.
